concepts.name: Signal W
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished logo concept for the self-hosted streaming app named exactly "watch.local". Concept 01: Signal W. An original bold geometric W symbol built from three soft rounded signal ribbons; a subtle right-facing play-shaped negative space is integrated into the middle. Ice-blue and white mark on a solid near-black #090b10 background. Below the mark, the exact lowercase wordmark "watch.local" in refined clean sans-serif. Square logo presentation, centered with generous margins, mark occupies about half the canvas, wordmark clearly legible. Flat vector-like branding with exceptionally clean geometry, memorable at small app-icon sizes, calm premium streaming-service feel. No device mockup, no glossy 3D, no additional words, no watermark, no existing company logo. This is one of ten alternative design directions, not a collage.
